theorem bbolt.Tx.allocate_f.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (hLogger : bbolt.DB.Logger.spec) (hAlloc

    bbolt.internal.common.Page.Id.spec) (hCount : bbolt.TxStats.IncPageCount.spec) (hPAlloc :
    bbolt.TxStats.IncPageAlloc.spec) : bbolt.Tx.allocate_f.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Tx.allocate_f.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (fr : Bool) (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (count : w64)
    (P : IProp GF),
    0 < sint.Z count →
      sint.nat count * 4096 < 2 ^ 62 →
        X.t.mv.txid' = w.wtxid →
          BitVec.toNat X.t.mv.pgid' * 4096 ≤ bbolt.mapLen w.ms →
            bbolt.derefPre X →
              bbolt.liveFresh X →
                bbolt.liveReach X →
                  ⊢
                    ∀ Φ,
                      bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW' fr K tx X.v w ∗ bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ p err,
                              bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P ∗
                                  ((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      ∃ X' w' id,
                                        bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
                                          bbolt.wdbW' fr K tx X'.v w' ∗
                                            ⌜bbolt.allocRes X X' w.fl w'.fl w.wtxid (sint.nat count) p id ∧
                                                w'.C = w.C ∧
                                                  BitVec.toNat X'.t.mv.pgid' * 4096 ≤ bbolt.mapLen w'.ms ∧
                                                    (w' = w.withFl w'.fl ∨ bbolt.wdbRemap w w')⌝) ∨
                                    ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      fmtErrorOk err ∗
                                        (bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW' fr K tx X.v w ∨
                                          ∃ X' w',
                                            bbolt.wtxLost K tx r m X' ∗
                                              bbolt.wdbLost' fr K tx X'.v w' ∗
                                                ⌜(∃ Xd b, bbolt.derefRel X Xd ∧ X' = Xd.rebase b) ∧
                                                    w'.C = w.C ∧ w'.fl = w.fl⌝)) -∗
                                Φ (intoVal p, intoVal err)) -∗
                          WP
                            ((intoVal
                                (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Tx.ty.PointerType
                                  go!"allocate" (intoVal tx)))
                              (intoVal count))
                            {{ Φ }}
